story.en: Holy Mass follows the images arriving at Porta Mariae around 18:30 in the 2026 report. The ninety-minute replay and car-free precinct are illustrative. The project owner marked the crowd boundary on 2026-10-07; devotees fill the forecourt and east garden facing the Cathedral, with no outdoor stage.

sources.title: Daily Tribune: 2026 Traslación
sources.note: Reports both images reaching Porta Mariae around 18:30, followed by Holy Mass, with about 820,000 devotees. The number drawn is illustrative.

sources.title: Project owner: Cathedral precinct annotation
sources.note: Project owner annotated atlas image, 2026-10-07. Boundary fitted around the annotated forecourt and mapped east garden with a four-metre curb margin. On 2026-10-08 the owner removed the illustrative outdoor altar stage; placement is approximate, not a surveyed festival arrangement.
